# Veritas

VALO receipt layer (LA6). Attest observations and follow-on receipts. No interpretation.

## Start here
- `README.md` — doctrine, contracts, quick start
- `src/veritas/contracts.py` — canonical receipt contracts
- `src/veritas/service.py` — chain service
- `src/veritas/worm.py` — WORM ledger
- `repo-manifest.yaml` — metadata

## Doctrine
- Attest, don't interpret (rejects analysis fields).
- Append-only WORM, SHA-256 hash-chained.
- Deterministic stable-JSON digests.
- Provenance-first.

## Development
`pytest -q` · `ruff check src tests` · `mypy src/veritas`
PEP 668: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q`
